snippet.title: Revenant of Tsushima | Official Teaser Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
⛩️ **THE FREE STEAM DEMO IS OUT NOW!**

Enter a forgotten world of Japanese folklore, wandering spirits, and ancient rituals.

🎮 **Play the FREE demo & wishlist on Steam:**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5529920/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=rot_demo_202611&utm_content=teaser_trailer

---

**Revenant of Tsushima (津島・魂鬼)** is a first-person Japanese folk-horror adventure developed by Hong Kong-based indie game studio Aurora Studio.

Set in a fictional world inspired by the Edo-period Tōkaidō, the story follows **Tsushima Mewa**, a shrine maiden who awakens centuries after a failed sealing ritual.

With fragmented memories and a mysterious past, Mewa must uncover the truth behind forgotten spirits, ancient rituals, and the forces that bind her to this world.

Explore atmospheric shrines, abandoned paths, and haunted graveyards. Discover traces of the unseen, interact with wandering spirits, and uncover the mysteries of a world shaped by Japanese folklore.

**AVAILABLE NOW: FREE DEMO**

Experience an early development build featuring:
- First-person exploration of Japanese-inspired environments
- Haunted graveyards and mysterious shrines
- Spirit encounters and collection mechanics
- Environmental storytelling and atmospheric horror

*The free demo is a work-in-progress build. Features and content may change during development.*

---
